name: Oakenscowl
summary: At Lake Al'Ameth, blight spreads from Oakenscowl, once a guardian of Teldrassil. Denalan asks you to end the threat. The maddened timberling dwells in a cave on the lake's southern bank.

sections.title: A Fallen Guardian
sections.body: Timberlings tend Teldrassil's boughs, and Oakenscowl once led them. Now corruption reaches the world tree's humble wildlife and ancient protectors alike. A massive growth swells across Oakenscowl's bark and drives the timberling mad. Its old duty was to guard the forest. Now blight takes hold.

sections.title: Purging Lake Al'Ameth
sections.body: Oakenscowl hides in a cavern on Lake Al'Ameth's southern shore. From there, it poisons nearby water and woodland beasts. Denalan cannot face the creature alone, so he seeks its destruction. He hopes to cut off the corruption and study the strange growth afflicting the lake's spirits.

aliases: what kind of creature is oakenscowl
faq.answer: Oakenscowl is a massive timberling, a forest spirit tied to Teldrassil's plant life. It once led its kind before a malignant growth took hold.
Oakenscowl's massive growth has twisted its mind and made it violently aggressive. From its cavern by Lake Al'Ameth, it spreads blight to nearby timberlings and beasts.
Oakenscowl dwells in a cavern on the southern shore of Lake Al'Ameth in southern Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who is Denalan and why is he studying the tumor?
faq.answer: Denalan is an herbalist and naturalist who lives on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore. He studies the world tree's plants and animals, seeking to understand and cure the strange rot infecting local timberlings.

faq.q: What caused the tumor on Oakenscowl?
faq.answer: Oakenscowl's tumor points to a deeper sickness spreading through Teldrassil's soil and roots. It corrupts nature spirits from within.
By the time adventurers find Oakenscowl, its affliction has gone too far. The growth has completely warped the timberling, and Denalan calls for a mercy kill.

angles.text: As a druid, you see a guardian timberling warped by strange growths. Teldrassil's young ecosystem is deeply unwell.
As a night elf, you see Oakenscowl's fall threaten Lake Al'Ameth, just south of Dolanaar and close to the heart of your people.
As an herbalist, you see how unseen rot twists plant life into malignant, mossy blights as you help Denalan.
